system.description:
You unleash all of your pent of fury into an endless flurry of attacks. Make 3 melee taijutsu attacks. On hit, deal your [Weapons damage] + 3d12. Each time you score a hit against the same creature increase the next Taijutsu attack against them critical threat range by +2, up to a maximum of +4. This jutsu’s maximum critical threat range is +4.

Each time you score a critical hit with this jutsu you release a roar that shakes everyone to their core. All hostile creatures that can see and hear you within 40 feet must make a Wisdom saving throw gaining 2 ranks of Demoralized on a failure.

If you have Fury, you can spend it to make this Jutsu’s critical threat range +6, instead of +4.

Chain 3: If this jutsu scores a critical hit, All creatures who make their saving throws make them with disadvantage.
